posts.name: Browzer
posts.tagline: Put your technical content on autopilot
posts.description: Connect your GitHub repo and Browzer drafts your docs, guides, changelogs, cookbooks, quickstarts, and SEO & AEO friendly blog posts, and then heals them on every merge. We automate all technical output of a DevRel so that DevRel teams can focus more on community, growth & events.

posts.name: Monid
posts.tagline: OpenRouter for agent tools
posts.description: We connect your AI agent to 1,800+ APIs without any subscriptions. SEO, lead gen, video/music generation, social media, stocks, market trends, on-chain data, competitor tracking, sentiment analysis, all unlocked with one key.

posts.name: Articos
posts.tagline: Launch with confidence, not gut instinct
posts.description: Articos helps SaaS teams, agencies, and founders test messaging, positioning, and landing pages against simulated personas matched to your ICP. Real audience signal in under 30 minutes. Peer-reviewed at 86% human accuracy vs Baymard and Nielsen Norman.

posts.name: CleanShot 5.0 with Studio Mode
posts.tagline: Mac-native app for screenshots, recordings and collaboration
posts.description: CleanShot is the definitive Mac-native toolkit for screenshots, recordings and collaboration. The new Studio Mode is all you need to turn a simple screen recording into a polished, professional video — with the quality you expect from CleanShot. Available now on all plans. No subscription required.

posts.name: Dial
posts.tagline: Give your AI agent a real phone number in 10 seconds
posts.description: Your agent can deploy in seconds but cannot get a phone number. Dial fixes that - one API call and it gets a real one in about 10 seconds. It places and receives voice calls, sends and receives SMS in 200+ countries, and messages over iMessage. It can even read inbound verification codes, so phone-gated signups stop being a dead end. Works via REST API, CLI, MCP servers, and SDKs. Free credit on signup, no card.

posts.name: OpenClaw 2.0
posts.tagline: The AI that really does things
posts.description: OpenClaw 2.0 simplifies setup by detecting ChatGPT or Claude keys automatically and lets configuration happen through chats with the agent itself. It adds multiplayer team features for sharing sessions, refreshed browser tools for better tracking, and memory upgrades, all while running personal AI helpers locally on devices for tasks like browser control and file management.

posts.name: Parasocial
posts.tagline: A fast, native podcast player for power listeners.
posts.description: PARASOCIAL is a fast, native podcast player for people who really love podcasts. Get new episodes the moment they publish, automatically download and organize them with smart playlist rules, search huge libraries instantly, bookmark and tag favorites, and share your parasocial relationship with friends. Native on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and CarPlay, with seamless sync and no account required.

posts.name: Dyson CameraJet
posts.tagline: Precision-floss between teeth while you brush
posts.description: The Dyson CameraJet combines sonic brushing with automated water flossing. An onboard macro camera detects interdental gaps at 28 fps to fire targeted conical bursts of mouthwash while you brush, removing the need for a separate flossing step.

posts.name: Claude Fable 5.1
posts.tagline: Claude’s most advanced models for coding and knowledge work
posts.description: Claude’s most advanced models for coding and knowledge work. Their research capabilities also offer an early glimpse of how AI models will contribute to scientific progress.

posts.name: RoundOS
posts.tagline: Free Docsend alternative
posts.description: Stop paying for basic infrastructure. RoundOS Data Room: free, forever — the real alternative to DocSend, Papermark, and every other VDR. Share the deck, build the diligence room, gate it with watermarks and NDAs, and read the analytics behind every open. All of it, free.

posts.name: Stitch AI by Dynamic Mockups
posts.tagline: The first embroidery digitizing agent
posts.description: Stitch reads your artwork the way a professional digitizer would - planning stitch direction, density, and pull compensation region by region. In 15 seconds, you get all you need: machine file, production sheet, stitch count, lifestyle mockup preview to pitch to your client.

posts.name: deepeye by deepidv
posts.tagline: The deepfake detector that goes where you browse
posts.description: deepeye flags AI-generated and manipulated images, video, and audio as you browse. Free on Chrome and live inside WhatsApp, it checks the profile photo, the video call, the voice note, in the moment, with no uploads and no dashboard. Built by deepidv, sharpened with Scam.AI Partnership.

posts.name: Doop
posts.tagline: Design with AI agents - live on the same canvas
posts.description: Doop is an infinite multiplayer canvas where AI agents design beside you. Claude, Codex and any MCP agent stream frames onto the canvas live, review each other's work, and share one memory of your decisions, design taste and context. Bring your own AI subscriptions, no platform tokens, no markup. Open source.

posts.name: Onset MCP
posts.tagline: Write and publish release notes from your AI assistant
posts.description: The changelog is the last chore of every release, so hand it to the agent that wrote the code. Onset MCP lets Claude or Cursor draft, schedule, and publish your release notes without leaving the editor. Free plan, no credit card.

posts.name: Touchy
posts.tagline: An iOS assistant that understands the world around you
posts.description: The AI assistant that handles it quietly, so you can stay in the moment. Ask a quick question, then put your phone back away.

posts.name: Userlens
posts.tagline: AI agent to improve product adoption
posts.description: Userlens helps SaaS teams turn product behavior into timely, personal guidance. Lumi, our adoption agent, combines warehouse and analytics data to understand every account, find users who are falling behind, and draft the right message for their context. You set the goal, audience, tone, and guardrails. Lumi personalizes each nudge and measures whether users actually adopt the feature.

posts.name: Basedash AI Sources
posts.tagline: Trust every AI answer by seeing what built it
posts.description: Basedash AI Sources shows exactly what produced every answer. Open Sources to inspect the tables, definitions, charts, data sources, read-only MCP connections, and web pages the AI used—plus every query, its SQL, and a preview of returned rows. Completed work collapses into a compact “Analyzed for…” summary, while actions that change something appear as clear cards beneath the answer. Ask the question, then see the receipts.

posts.name: HydraDB OSS
posts.tagline: Now open source: the fastest, cheapest graph DB
posts.description: HydraDB is a native graph database built for AI infrastructure — memory, ontologies, and agent context. Today, we're open sourcing the core: the fastest, cheapest graph DB on the market, built directly on object storage. One API call gets you core primitives, sub-200ms latency, and none of the operational overhead of legacy graph databases. We built HydraDB because AI applications need graph-native context, not bolted-on workarounds. Try it, break it, contribute — it's yours now.

posts.name: Roadie
posts.tagline: Keep your Mac on the right microphone and speakers
posts.description: Roadie is a menu-bar audio switcher for Mac. Rank microphones and speakers once, and it automatically restores the best available device after reconnects, wake, login, or macOS changes. Manual choices still win until the device set changes. Pause anytime, avoid unwanted outputs, and stay private: routing runs locally and Roadie never captures audio.

posts.name: Porte
posts.tagline: Control your local Grok sessions from your phone
posts.description: Porte is an open-source phone remote control built specifically for Grok Build. Pair your phone with your machine, then read live transcripts, send prompts and files, run slash commands, stop turns, and answer permission requests.

posts.name: GhostReply
posts.tagline: AI auto-replier for iMessage on your Mac
posts.description: GhostReply is an AI auto-replier for iMessage that runs in Terminal on your Mac. It learns how you text each person, watches only the conversations you choose, and replies in your style. This release adds hosted AI, so there is no API key to create. Try 10 replies free, then pay $4.99 once.

posts.name: Dynamic Edge
posts.tagline: The Dynamic Island for Windows
posts.description: Dynamic Edge brings a Dynamic Island-style experience to Windows 10 and 11. It combines media controls, clipboard history, app and folder launching, timers, volume controls, and more into a lightweight floating interface. Built with native WinUI 3 and Windows App SDK, it is designed to feel at home on Windows without the overhead of Electron. You can dock it to the top, left, or right of your screen, use it across multiple monitors, and quickly summon it with a global hotkey or Magic Shake.

posts.name: NextAdmin
posts.tagline: Open-source Next.js admin dashboard, built for AI agents
posts.description: Free, open-source Next.js admin dashboard with 200+ components, AGENTS.md rules, Agent Skills, and a prompt library. Built to keep AI coding agents consistent instead of reinventing every page or generating AI slop. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI agents can read the project once, understand your patterns, and build new features and UI that match them instead of inventing something new every session.

posts.name: Crosspublish
posts.tagline: Create better content, and publish everywhere it matters.
posts.description: A Typefully and Buffer alternative that supports all major social networks, with a rich editor for each one. Use it from the dashboard or from Claude, ChatGPT, or any LLM via MCP.

posts.name: AdArena
posts.tagline: 🏆 ONE BRIEF. AN ARMY OF CREATORS. MAY THE BEST AD WIN.
posts.description: AdArena is the AI Advertising League. Brands launch one brief, and AI creators compete by submitting finished ads. The best ad wins — giving brands more shots at finding winning creative, while creators build a real track record through competition. Already: 1,330+ creators, 12 competitions, 900+ ads created, $100K+ in prize pools, and $50K+ paid to creators. Real brands. Real briefs. Real prizes.

posts.name: Wircle
posts.tagline: A professional social network for humans and AI agents.
posts.description: Wircle.com is a verified identity network. You get a clean handle at Wircle plus a profile for yourself, your company, or your AI agent. Open API by default, so LLMs can actually read it. In Beta now, and the first 100 users get auto followed.

posts.name: GeoRankers
posts.tagline: Know where you stand in AI search - and what to do about it
posts.description: Most AI visibility tools tell you where you stand - GeoRankers helps you improve it. Track how your brand shows up across ChatGPT, Google AI Search, and Perplexity, see where competitors are winning, and find out which sources are shaping those answers. Then, act on specific recommendations and retest to see what actually moved the needle. Built for B2B SaaS marketing, SEO, and growth teams.

posts.name: Unitpost
posts.tagline: Let AI-Agents generate and send production-ready Emails.
posts.description: One platform for every email you send: transactional and marketing. One contact list, one balance, one API. Describe a welcome series or a campaign and Unitpost builds it. You approve. Same actions in the dashboard, API, SDKs, and AI agents via MCP.

posts.name: fedt.ai
posts.tagline: Is your site agent ready? Probably not.
posts.description: AI agents are becoming the new users of the web. fedt.ai checks whether your site is ready for them. See what agents can find, understand, and act on. Start with a free preview scan, then unlock the Fix Pack: a deeper report with evidence-backed issues, prioritised fixes, and clear next steps.

posts.name: Authorizer
posts.tagline: Open-source auth for enterprise applications, and AI agents
posts.description: Own your identity layer. Self-host open-source auth—OAuth2, OIDC, SAML SSO, SCIM, passkeys, MFA, OpenFGA—with permission-aware AI on your own data.

posts.name: SerpApi
posts.tagline: Give Your AI Agents Live Search Data with 50% Fewer Tokens
posts.description: You can now receive results from 100+ web search engines SerpApi already supports as clean, structured Markdown, using roughly 50% fewer tokens than JSON on average. Very simple integration with your AI workflows. Built for LLMs, AI agents, and agentic workflows.

posts.name: Fensory
posts.tagline: Turn Claude or ChatGPT into your personal trading desk
posts.description: Your AI agent gets a real trading account, not a chatbot bolted onto a broker. One MCP URL connects Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to 1,900+ assets: US stocks, treasuries, gold and 250+ perps. People run funding arbs, basis trades, self-rebalancing macro portfolios and full quant desks through it, in plain language or Python, 24/7, inside hard limits enforced on the account. Non-custodial: the agent can trade, it can never withdraw. Cloud-hosted agents ship soon.

posts.name: Glance - Home Screen Feeds
posts.tagline: AI agents on your Home Screen
posts.description: Glance brings AI agents to your iPhone Home Screen. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, OpenClaw, or any MCP-compatible agent to create and update dynamic widgets with the information that matters to you. Agents can display briefings, news, metrics, tasks, messages, live data, and more—automatically and throughout the day. Instead of staying inside a chat, your agents can now communicate with you at a glance.

posts.name: Trikon Voice
posts.tagline: Human-like AI voice agents, built for India
posts.description: Trikon AI Voice is a voice AI platform built specifically for India. Businesses can deploy AI voice agents to handle customer calls, lead qualification, follow-ups, reminders, and other repetitive phone conversations - helping teams automate calling without losing the natural flow of a real conversation.

posts.name: Mirrago Fashion App
posts.tagline: Virtual AI try on before you buy
posts.description: See how clothes look on you before you buy them. With Mirrago, simply upload your photo, choose an outfit, and get a realistic virtual try-on in seconds. Explore different looks and find your style with confidence.

posts.name: Decispher Memory
posts.tagline: Memory for coding agents that learns how your team works
posts.description: Your AI coding agent forgets everything between sessions so you explain pnpm and the staging port again every morning. Decispher Memory keeps preferences, environment facts, and team norms across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok Build. Choose Engineering or Everything mode; keep memories yours, share them with a project, or attach team sets. Personal stays personal, every memory use is logged, and deletion is immediate.

posts.name: FreeScan.app
posts.tagline: Know what your website is missing and exactly what to fix
posts.description: FreeScan shows what your website is missing, why it matters, and what to fix next. Run a free 38-check audit across SEO, AI visibility, security, accessibility, and design, with evidence behind every result. Pro adds private whole-site scans, prioritized fix workspaces, scan history, weekly reports, and uptime monitoring.

posts.name: VideoDuck
posts.tagline: Free video compressor for iPhone. No subscription.
posts.description: Free video compressor for iPhone. Shrink videos right on your device – no uploads, no cloud, no account. Batch-compress your camera roll, keep or replace originals, and see exactly how much space you freed. Pro is a one-time unlock, never a subscription.

posts.name: PaisaLens
posts.tagline: 100% private, on-device expense tracker for Android (India)
posts.description: PaisaLens automatically captures your digital expenses from bank & UPI SMS using on-device, local AI—keeping your financial data 100% private and on your phone. Designed for total user control: don't want AI auto-capture? Turn it off anytime. Don't want to pay? Use manual expense entry for free forever. PaisaLens gives you an affordable, private, and flexible alternative to cloud-based expense trackers.

posts.name: Atlas
posts.tagline: A world model for spatial intelligence
posts.description: Atlas is World Labs' omni world model for spatial intelligence. Give it one image or many, plus a camera path, and it generates consistent new views, 3D reconstructions, and long videos. Early access is open, and it will power future versions of Marble.

posts.name: FranklyMail
posts.tagline: Email on your own domain. $9 a year, unlimited mailboxes
posts.description: Unlimited users, unlimited domains, email on your own domain. $9 a year, no per-seat math.Most email hosts bill you per person. A mail server doesn't work that way. It costs storage and bandwidth, so that's what we charge for. $9 a year gets you unlimited mailboxes, unlimited domains, and 10 GB pooled storage. Extra storage is $0.40/GB/year. One plan, no tiers, 30-day refund. IMAP, POP3, SMTP, JMAP, webmail, aliases, catch-all, Sieve filters, 2FA. Bring a domain you own and add four DNS records.

posts.name: Journey Sparks - Launch!
posts.tagline: walk, notice, learn about your surrounding
posts.description: City Blindness is real- we stop noticing the place we live in. Journey Sparks fixes that with walking prompts, powered by Gemini, that nudges you to notice something and photograph it. Choose WHERE you wander (Wander, Guided, or Target) and WHAT you're curious about, and get a prompt built for that exact walk. Finish, and you get a keepsake: a poetic postcard and your mapped route. Not a hiking app. Not a map. A companion for rediscovering your own city. Live on iOS App Store now.

posts.name: tam
posts.tagline: The AI-native workspace for mixed human and AI teams
posts.description: Your AI assistants write briefs, do the tasks, check for bugs, and keep the board up to date. Your team focuses on decisions – the AI handles the mechanical…

posts.name: gigstr
posts.tagline: Your gig diary. Every show, setlist, photo and stat in one.
posts.description: Gigstr is a diary for live music. Log every gig and festival you've been to, rate them, add photos and videos, and get setlists synced automatically from setlist.fm. See your stats — top artists, venues, genres — and follow friends to compare gig histories. Got an envelope full of old ticket stubs? Take and upload pics of them to add them to your history, all details extracted for you.

posts.name: ReviewProof Studio
posts.tagline: Turn Every Review into Your Next Customer
posts.description: ReviewProof Studio pulls real reviews from Google Business Profile and Trustpilot then turns them into branded posts, ads, website proof, review replies and social content. Built for small businesses and agencies that want customer proof to win more trust.

posts.name: Klaussy Desktop
posts.tagline: Hand it a ticket. Come back to a green PR. Free and local.
posts.description: Runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot and 7 more side by side, each in its own git worktree. Review PRs, debug CI, and catch bugs at commit time. No backend, no token markup: your machine, your keys, your provider's price. Free for individual devs.

posts.name: Steerd
posts.tagline: One place for the whole job, inquiry to paid invoice
posts.description: An all-in-one platform for freelancers and small businesses. An inquiry becomes a project, your profile becomes a CV, hours and travel expenses land on it, and the invoice comes out of those hours. One thread, nothing typed twice. 30 days free, no card.

posts.name: askOdin
posts.tagline: AI due-diligence & deck stress-testing for startups and VCs
posts.description: We benchmarked 2,488 pitch decks and found a median clarity score of just 35/100, proving that most startup deals fail on unverified assumptions rather than bad ideas. askOdin provides auditable judgment infrastructure for private capital. Founders use our Crucible engine to stress-test decks and fix logic gaps before pitching, while VCs and analysts get deterministic, auditable risk scoring with complete proof logs. Stop reading surface-level LLM summaries and start verifying judgment.

posts.name: RACESTARTUP
posts.tagline: Race for attention. Win real traction.
posts.description: List your project. Use Nitro. Push it to #1.RaceStartup is a live competition where startups race for visibility and communities boost the projects they believe in. Every boost adds points, builds momentum, and moves a startup closer to #1.

posts.name: SoundToMIDI
posts.tagline: Turn audio into editable MIDI in your browser
posts.description: SoundToMIDI turns MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG, and compatible MP4 files into editable MIDI on your device. Preview the detected notes on a piano roll, compare the original with Raw and Cleaned MIDI, then download the Raw MIDI for free. Cleaned MIDI is an optional $2.99 one-time purchase. Clear melodies and isolated instruments work best.

posts.name: Anvay
posts.tagline: Reconnect with the timeless wisdom
posts.description: We often inherit prayers as words before we inherit their meaning. Anvay helps people read Hindu prayers in the original, follow them in Hinglish and understand the ideas and context behind them.

posts.name: TrackMCP
posts.tagline: Google Analytics for MCP Servers
posts.description: TrackMCP shows who is using your MCP server, what they are trying to do, whether the work gets done, and where to improve. All from one line of code.

posts.name: Safemenu - Digital Menu, Allergen Filter
posts.tagline: Digital Food Safety & QR Menus for Modern Kitchens
posts.description: SafeMenu simplifies food safety compliance. Manage 14 allergens, generate instant QR menus, and protect guests with smart allergen profiles that hide unsafe meals. Built for food trucks and pop-ups—no complicated setup, just safety simplified.

posts.name: WhisPaste
posts.tagline: Free, open-source dictation that runs on your machine
posts.description: WhisPaste turns OpenAI's Whisper into a real desktop app: press a hotkey, speak, and the transcript is pasted at your cursor - in any app, on Windows, macOS or Linux. Offline by default - whisper.cpp runs locally, audio never leaves your device Free & open source (MIT) - no account, no subscription Broad hardware support - Vulkan, Metal, CPU fallback Built for anyone who wants to write at the speed of speech, privately.

posts.name: Markdown TTS: Read Aloud & AI Narration
posts.tagline: TTS + AI narration for code, docs, and git diffs in VS Code
posts.description: Markdown TTS reads markdown, code, and docs aloud, or has AI explain them in plain language — including narrating git diffs before you commit, so you catch what changed by ear instead of skimming. Choose neural or fully offline voices. Bring your own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Groq key (Groq's free tier works out of the box) — nothing leaves your machine without it. Also includes voice input to Copilot Chat, so you can talk instead of type.

posts.name: Gmail Email Guard
posts.tagline: Enterprise-grade phishing protection, no IT team required.
posts.description: Ever paused before clicking a link in Gmail, thinking "is this real?" CyberCheck360 Email Guard is the fix. It sits inside Gmail, checks every link in real time, and flags anything known to be malicious. Preview risky pages or open dodgy files in a secure sandbox, before they can touch your machine. Enterprise-grade phishing protection, no IT team needed. Built for accountants, freelancers, small business owners, and anyone whose inbox is the business. CyberCheck360 - Protecting Every Click!

posts.name: hosted·ai
posts.tagline: Turn your GPU infrastructure into a profitable AI cloud
posts.description: hosted·ai is the turnkey GPUaaS platform for service providers, neoclouds, CSPs, and telcos to launch and scale profitable AI clouds. Today's GPU infrastructure wastes 60-80% of capacity. hosted·ai fixes that - with software-defined GPU, true multi-tenancy, overcommit, and a capacity-sharing network (GPU Mesh) - delivering 5x more revenue and margin per GPU. No upfront licensing. No per-seat fees. From zero to neocloud in weeks.

posts.name: Ferrum
posts.tagline: Run local LLMs with one Rust binary
posts.description: Ferrum is an open-source, Rust-native runtime for running and serving local language models on Apple Silicon Metal and NVIDIA CUDA. One binary gives you an interactive CLI plus OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses APIs, without requiring Python, PyTorch, or vLLM at runtime. Choose a model explicitly, run it locally, or expose the same model over HTTP.

posts.name: Tab Review Marker
posts.tagline: Turn open tabs into a visible review queue
posts.description: Mark each source as To Review, Reviewed, or Needs Attention directly on its favicon. Add notes, keep duplicate tabs in sync, and export a local review queue for ChatGPT, Claude, or Codex without sending page content anywhere.

posts.name: Cortex — Robotics Observability
posts.tagline: Lightweight observability for robot fleets
posts.description: Cortex is a monitoring tool for robot fleets. Install a lightweight agent on your Raspberry Pi with one command and get a live dashboard showing CPU, memory, temperature, errors and ROS2 nodes in real time. Built for robotics teams who want visibility into what their robots are actually doing without building their own monitoring stack from scratch.

posts.name: PaneCrew
posts.tagline: Run multiple AI coding agents at once, in one grid
posts.description: A free, open-source VS Code extension that grids your CLI agent sessions — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI — across a multi-root workspace, with a focus-following file explorer.

posts.name: FileSathi
posts.tagline: Know the moment your prospect reads your proposal
posts.description: Share proposals, decks, and quotes as tracked links instead of dead attachments. See exactly who opened your document, how long they spent on each page, and watch a session replay of how they read it like looking over their shoulder. Every viewer is automatically scored 0–100 and tagged Hot, Warm, or Cold, so you always know who to call first. No login needed for recipients they just click. Free forever plan, 5 documents, no card required.

posts.name: Spaife
posts.tagline: One running tax estimate across everything you earn
posts.description: Tax calculators are one-shot: enter numbers, get a guess, forget it. Spaife keeps one running federal estimate that updates as you earn — W-2 paychecks, stock and crypto trades, side gigs, betting — one number you can watch move. Event-sourced under the hood, so every estimate traces back to the exact income events behind it. Early access; estimates, not tax advice.

posts.name: Infrabase.ai
posts.tagline: Find European AI infrastructure, verified by hand
posts.description: Tools whose operating company is under EU, EEA, UK or Swiss law, not just tools with an EU data centre. 61 companies, verified against their own legal pages.

posts.name: SilentCrush
posts.tagline: Talk to your crush and stay anonymous until you're ready
posts.description: SilentCrush turns a crush confession into a conversation. 💜 Send your crush an anonymous message and, if they reply, get 7 days to chat, flirt, play games like This or That and Would You Rather, and discover if the feeling is mutual — all without revealing your identity. When you're ready, reveal yourself. No pressure, just a little mystery.

posts.name: Narrative Lion
posts.tagline: Study any video to build your playbook and create from it
posts.description: Most AI tools analyze video through transcripts. Narrative Lion watches the video itself: visual hooks, shot pacing, camera transitions, broken down shot by shot. Unlike general-purpose research tools (NotebookLM), it's built for content creators. Every analysis becomes a reusable formula card. Save your proven formulas into collections. When you create, pin collections and notes to the AI. It reads everything you've studied and gives you a draft where every line traces back to a source.

posts.name: Pocket Companion
posts.tagline: Super intelligent and interactive companion.
posts.description: PoCo isn’t another chatbot—it’s an AI-powered digital twin that learns how you think, work, and grow. It combines a Personal Assistant, Companion, and reflective guide in one system, remembering context across conversations and adapting over time. PoCo helps manage goals, tasks, reminders, stress, and reflection while knowing when to listen rather than fix. Built privacy-first, it’s designed to become a disciplined extension of you—not another distracting AI feed.

posts.name: MealTap — Tap. Tap. Done.
posts.tagline: From “nothing sounds good” to dinner.
posts.description: MealTap helps you get from “what should I cook?” to dinner without endless recipe scrolling. Start with a quick meal, plan your week around your mood, or browse Fresh Ideas when nothing sounds good. Find an idea you like and turn it into a complete recipe when you're ready. From there, MealTap keeps going: add meals to your calendar, build your grocery list automatically, and cook with step-by-step guidance. Tap. Tap. Done.

posts.name: AIssie
posts.tagline: AI voice and chat receptionist for service businesses
posts.description: Most small businesses lose work to a ringing phone. We called 180 Australian tradies and 60% of calls went unanswered. AIssie answers every call and chat 24/7 in a natural voice, qualifies the job, books it straight into the calendar, sends reminders and chases unpaid invoices. It plugs into Xero, ServiceM8, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, WhatsApp, HubSpot amdpre. Australian-built, data hosted in Australia, live from day one. No hiring, no training, no missed jobs.

posts.name: HandyXlate
posts.tagline: Translate text on Android screens without switching apps
posts.description: HandyXlate is an Android screen translator for reading without switching apps. Tap the floating bubble to capture a single frame, run OCR on-device, and place translated text back over the screen. It works across apps, images, and manga, with manga-aware reading order, word lookup, pronunciation, and a personal wordbook. Screenshots are not uploaded; only recognized text is sent for translation.

posts.name: BeaconChess
posts.tagline: A chess coach that suggests moves and explains why they work
posts.description: Play human-like opponents from ~1100 to ~2000. Beacon suggests useful moves, explains why they work, and shows mistakes and missed tactics in plain English, right on the board. Your games stay on your device. Pay once for a personal license. No subscription.

posts.name: Reechy
posts.tagline: Your complete video workspace, built into the browser
posts.description: Reechy is a complete video workspace in your browser. Record camera, screen or both with a teleprompter, upload files or paste a video link. Trim, crop and caption them. Publish one video or arrange several on a page with notes, links, buttons, forms and calendars. Send or embed it, control access, make recipient links, collect replies, and see opens and watch time. It works on desktop and mobile for demos, outreach, portfolios, lessons, playlists and personal messages.

posts.name: Nook
posts.tagline: Track your home’s systems, tasks, documents, and maintenance
posts.description: Nook helps households keep track of home systems, maintenance tasks, warranties, documents, notes, and due dates in one place. Ask Nook lets you chat with your saved home records to find install dates, upcoming maintenance, manuals, and details you do not want to dig for later. Built by a mom and an 11-year-old son duo, now in beta. Keep your household on the same page.

posts.name: The Six-Year Sky
posts.tagline: Illustrated timeline of the sky battles of WW2
posts.description: An interactive history of aviation in the Second World War: Blitzkrieg, the Battle of Britain, Pearl Harbor, Midway, the bomber offensive, D-Day, the first jets and the atomic missions, with wireframe aircraft that fly as you scroll, documentary photographs and links to the primary sources.

posts.name: ViolationFlow
posts.tagline: HOA violation case tracking for self-managed boards
posts.description: ViolationFlow gives self-managed HOA and condo boards one dated record for every violation and ARC case. Send templated email notices, capture photo evidence and owner responses, track escalations and fines, import lots by CSV, and export audit-ready PDF timelines. The free plan covers 10 lots and 5 active cases.

posts.name: WhatIs
posts.tagline: Understand any AI website in 10 seconds
posts.description: Paste an AI website URL. Get what it is, who it's for, what it does, what it replaces, and how cheap it is to try — read from the site's own pages.

posts.name: Microsite Builder by Scrollytelling
posts.tagline: Describe your campaign, get an animated microsite
posts.description: Describe your campaign, product or event in one sentence and AI builds a complete microsite: copy, imagery and scroll-driven animations included. Start from ready-made templates for launches, events, promos and portfolios, then edit anything by hand or with AI, no code. Publish free to a scrollytelling.ai link or connect your own domain, embed it anywhere, or push it to WordPress and Shopify. Built on the Scrollytelling engine, so pages load fast and look premium on mobile.

posts.name: DiskPeek
posts.tagline: See what’s eating your disk. Fast.
posts.description: DiskPeek is a fast, no-nonsense disk space analyzer for Mac. It streams results while scanning, so you can start finding huge folders immediately instead of staring at a spinner. Delete something and totals update instantly. Finder-style navigation, keyboard-first controls, honest on-disk sizes, and privacy by design. No cleaner bloat, no account, no subscription. Buy it once and it’s yours.

posts.name: BaseballDraw
posts.tagline: Review baseball swings and pitches frame by frame
posts.description: BaseballDraw turns an iPhone or iPad into a focused baseball video-review tool. Record or import a swing or pitch, move frame by frame, draw on the clip, inspect on-device pose overlays and phase markers, compare reps side by side, add voice notes and tags, and share the exact moment you want to discuss. Videos stay on the device. No ads.

posts.name: The Six-Year Sky
posts.tagline: Illustrated timeline of the sky battles of WW2
posts.description: An interactive history of aviation in the Second World War: Blitzkrieg, the Battle of Britain, Pearl Harbor, Midway, the bomber offensive, D-Day, the first jets and the atomic missions, with wireframe aircraft that fly as you scroll, documentary photographs and links to the primary sources.

posts.name: Phrony
posts.tagline: Declare an agent in YAML. Run it outside your app code
posts.description: Agents outgrew application code. Phrony runs them somewhere else. Declare the agent in one YAML manifest, run it on the Phrony runtime, get a structured trace of every run. Policy is enforced by the executor, not prompted into the model. Self-host in five minutes.

posts.name: Infrabase.ai
posts.tagline: Find European AI infrastructure, verified by hand
posts.description: Tools whose operating company is under EU, EEA, UK or Swiss law, not just tools with an EU data centre. 61 companies, verified against their own legal pages.

posts.name: Nook
posts.tagline: Track your home’s systems, tasks, documents, and maintenance
posts.description: Nook helps households keep track of home systems, maintenance tasks, warranties, documents, notes, and due dates in one place. Ask Nook lets you chat with your saved home records to find install dates, upcoming maintenance, manuals, and details you do not want to dig for later. Built by a mom and an 11-year-old son duo, now in beta. Keep your household on the same page.

posts.name: BlockTheNews
posts.tagline: Protect your mental health and attention
posts.description: An app designed to stop the outrage. 672 news sites, one deliberate breath, zero tracking. For iPhone, iPad and Mac.

posts.name: holdit.life
posts.tagline: The app blocker that makes quitting harder than focusing
posts.description: Block any app in one tap. holdit.life tracks your focus as daily streaks and includes Strict Mode, preventing uninstalls mid-session so there is no easy way out. Custom modes for Deep Work, Sleep, Meditation, and more. Free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Pocket Companion
posts.tagline: Super intelligent and interactive companion.
posts.description: PoCo isn’t another chatbot—it’s an AI-powered digital twin that learns how you think, work, and grow. It combines a Personal Assistant, Companion, and reflective guide in one system, remembering context across conversations and adapting over time. PoCo helps manage goals, tasks, reminders, stress, and reflection while knowing when to listen rather than fix. Built privacy-first, it’s designed to become a disciplined extension of you—not another distracting AI feed.

posts.name: Summarly
posts.tagline: Your books, ready before they reach your accountant
posts.description: Snap a receipt or import your statement — Summarly reads each receipt, matches it to the right transaction, and categorises new spending from your own vendor history. From those approved lines it builds your four financial statements, your VAT position quarter by quarter, and every tax deadline a year ahead, costed from your real figures. Ask questions in plain English. Invoicing, payslips and documents are built in. Free plan, no card, and nothing posts to your books without your approval.

posts.name: indextkn
posts.tagline: AI Model Pricing Tracker
posts.description: Track AI model pricing across providers in one place. Get up-to-date prices via API, MCP, webhooks, or our SKILL, compare models and providers, and get notified when pricing changes. Built for developers who need reliable, current pricing data without maintaining it themselves.

posts.name: TranslateMyCall 2.0
posts.tagline: Free AI interpreter, just a phone call away. 47 languages.
posts.description: TranslateMyCall is back — rebuilt from scratch on ThunderPhone's production voice-AI pipeline, now faster and more accurate than the 2024 original. Call (228) 888-8666 from any phone — no app, no account — and an AI interpreter joins the line. Merge it into a call so each side hears their own language, or put it on speakerphone for in-person interpreting. 47 languages officially supported; others may work as well! Free for a limited time.

posts.name: Peppy: Peptide Tracker
posts.tagline: Track your peptide protocol like a pro!
posts.description: I built Peppy because tracking peptides and GLP-1s felt way more complicated than it needed to be. Too many calculators, notes, reminders and spreadsheets. So I vibe coded a simpler, privacy-first way to track doses, calculate units, manage vials and follow progress. A couple of months later, Peppy has crossed 1,000+ customers, completely bootstrapped. Still early, still building, and really excited to finally share it here. I'd love some feedback on the app.

posts.name: Stamperly
posts.tagline: Digital loyalty cards for local businesses
posts.description: Stamperly helps local businesses replace paper stamp cards with a simple digital loyalty program. Customers join by scanning a QR code — no app download needed — then collect stamps and redeem rewards from their phone. Businesses can create loyalty cards, manage staff and locations, and start free with up to 20 customers.

posts.name: Breeze DM
posts.tagline: Instagram comment-to-DM automation, no contact limits
posts.description: Breeze turns your Instagram into a 24/7 DM machine. When someone comments on a post or replies to your Story, Breeze auto-sends them a DM (the link, offer, or answer) through the official Meta API, no risky bots, no bans. Unlike ManyChat: Instagram-first, one flat price with no per-contact limits, and a lead only counts when someone actually replies. Visual flow builder, follower check, CSV export, and a founder who answers you directly.

posts.name: Saga
posts.tagline: Plan, cast, and shoot a serialized drama with AI.
posts.description: Saga is an AI showrunner for vertical serialized drama. Start from a proven template, ask what's trending, or bring your own idea. Saga builds the season arc, locks a character bible of faces and voices, and shoots 60 to 90 second portrait cliffhangers where the same cast carries from episode 1 to the finale. ▶ Locked character bible, every episode ▶ Storyboard approval before video is generated ▶ Full-screen vertical episodes for phone viewing

posts.name: Waivly - Join Today For Just $1
posts.tagline: Experience the platform where ambitious professionals belong
posts.description: Connect, learn, and grow in the private global network built for meaningful relationships, new opportunities, and lasting progress.

posts.name: Thana
posts.tagline: Privacy-first, offline-first period tracker PWA.
posts.description: Privacy-first, offline-first period tracker PWA. Your health data stays on your device with local PIN encryption.

posts.name: iHatePDF
posts.tagline: 48 PDF tools that run in your browser, not on a server
posts.description: iHatePDF is 48 PDF tools - merge, split, compress, sign, unlock, convert - that run entirely in your browser. Files are never uploaded, so there is nothing to delete afterwards. No account, no watermark, no size cap. Open a tab, drop a file, get it back.

posts.name: AllMy Support
posts.tagline: One inbox behind all your brands
posts.description: AllMy Support is an email-first helpdesk for small teams who run more than one brand. Each brand gets its own address, sender identity and help site. You work them all from one inbox. Brands are unlimited and free: you pay $9 a month plus $10 per agent.
